_what: M0c Session N Probe 2 -- THE COMBINER. The union-oracle says gold sits in some graph's top-3 for 97.78% of fit queries; the best measured combiner extracts 95.1%. Can a training-free vote close part of that gap?

_prior_reads_already_spent_on_this_quest.six_way_RRF: HELD-OUT ALREADY READ in runs/session-m0c-m/l4-heldout-read.json: R@3 0.8908 (+1 case over the shipped pair) but R@1 0.6769 (-5 cases). NOT re-probed here; treated as a recorded configuration.
_prior_reads_already_spent_on_this_quest.T3B_trained_combiner: fit-only artifact exists (six+T3B fit R@3 0.9432, cond@3 0.96); TRAINED ON FIT and never read. This probe does NOT re-run or extend it -- reading a trained arm is the collapse shape this project has paid for four times.

PRIMARY_six_vote_top3.definition: on the CURRENT narrowed ten: each of the six pinned graphs ranks the ten; a candidate's score = HOW MANY graphs place it in their own top-3; ties broken by the six-way RRF score (k=60). Admit top-3.
PRIMARY_six_vote_top3.why_primary: structurally matched to the oracle (the oracle IS the union of per-graph top-3s) yet completely training-free and knob-free.

SECONDARY_six_zsum.definition: per-query z-normalised logit sum across the six graphs over the narrowed ten (the m0c-m prereg's declared secondary family, extended from two graphs to the full membership). Admit top-3.
SECONDARY_six_zsum.why_registered: uses logit MAGNITUDES rather than ranks; the honest rival that needs no threshold.

instrument_gate: reconstructing the shipped PAIR cascade (L-2 narrow + L2xL-6 RRF) from freshly scored logits must reproduce the binary's fusion_rank order on 229/229 fit queries, exactly as Probe 1's gate did.

primary_six_vote_fit.R@3: 213 to 217 (base 213). The oracle bound allows up to ~218; I expect the vote to capture roughly a third to half of the oracle-to-pair gap because agreement is a weaker signal than truth.
primary_six_vote_fit.R@1: 176 to 184 (base 180) -- vote optimises set membership, not the head; direction at R@1 unknown.

earn_a_read_rule: an arm with fit R@3 >= 215 AND parameter-free earns ONE held-out read. If neither reaches 215, the probe closes with its numbers and the combiner gap is reported as captured-or-not. The trained T3B remains unread regardless -- its prior is four collapses.
latency_note: +4 batched forwards on CUDA (~+12 ms/query against a 29 ms P95); CPU deployments never run the cascade; the six-way latency objection was a CPU figure (the inversion error CLAUDE.md names).
what_will_not_be_done: no re-scoring or extension of T3B
no change to slate, narrowing, k, or admit
